title: French-Style Wine Beef Stew
description: A classic French-inspired beef stew made with tender beef short ribs, rich red wine, and a variety of vegetables in a flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary and sauté the carrots, onions, and celery until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the beef short ribs to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove from heat and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
